_comment: The Microsoft Entra app registration mail-graph signs in with. A PUBLIC client: the client ID is an identifier, not a secret, and there is no client secret. Register it with supported account types 'Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts' (that is what the 'common' authority requires) and a 'Mobile and desktop applications' redirect URI of http://localhost. A file at ~/.config/mchatai/mail-graph/client.json overrides this one.
